summary: The old harness could scan the 1500-deep sequence before the change. The new default scanner limit rejects it, while the fixed harness has no route to select the supported limit of 2000.

claims.necessity_reason: The after-source guard blocks a supported higher-limit scan that the fixed harness cannot configure.

before.requirement: Scan a balanced 1500-deep flow sequence; the scanner has no nesting guard below INT_MAX.
before.reason: The before scanner increments flow level without consulting the configurable limit. The unchanged harness supplies the sequence to that scanner.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: Dispatches each opening bracket to flow collection scanning.
Calls the before flow-level helper and consumes an opening bracket when it succeeds.

after.requirement: Scan that same balanced 1500-deep flow sequence with the supported nesting limit set to 2000.
after.reason: The new guard consults the limit, whose default is 1000. The harness never calls the setter, so scanning stops at the 1001st opening bracket.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: Defines the default limit read by the new guard.
Defines the supported setup that raises the limit.
Calls the after guard before consuming an opening bracket.

claims.comparison_reason: The identical input is accepted by the before scanner without changing the limit. After the change, accepting it requires a setter call absent from the same old harness.
